entries.question: I booked via helpline number but lost my appointment id
entries.answer:
If you booked an appointment through the KGMU helpline or online portals (such as ORS) and lost your appointment ID or slip, you can try the following steps:

1. **Check your SMS/Email:** If you provided a mobile number or email address during booking, a confirmation message containing the appointment details and ID is usually sent automatically.
2. **Contact KGMU Help Lines:** You can call the main KGMU helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333** to verify your appointment status and retrieve your ID using your registered mobile number and patient details.
3. **Visit the OPD Registration Counter:** On the day of your appointment, visit the registration counter at Gate 2 along with your registered mobile number and a valid government ID (such as Aadhaar). The staff can look up your booking in the system and print a duplicate OPD slip for the standard fee of ₹50.

For more details on booking methods, visit the [KGMU Courses & Admission page](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php) or check the official guidelines.

entries.question: I want opd appointment
entries.answer:
Online registration is mandatory for OPD appointments at KGMU. You can book an appointment using any of the following methods:

1. **Online via ORS:** Visit the [Online Registration System (ORS)](https://ors.gov.in), select Uttar Pradesh, choose KGMU, select the department, date, and time, enter patient details, and pay the ₹50 OPD slip fee to download your slip.
2. **Mobile Apps:** Use the ABHA or Health Care app by registering with your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same state and hospital selection steps.
3. **SMS:** Send an SMS in the format `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.
4. **Walk-in:** Visit the hospital with your Aadhaar number and active mobile number to complete OTP verification, collect a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee, and collect your OPD slip.

**Important Notes:**
- **Timings:** Monday to Friday 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM; Saturday 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM; closed on Sundays. The parchi/ticket counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp.
- **Fees:** The OPD slip fee is ₹50 for all booking methods.
- **Referrals:** Patients from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral for the specific department.
- **Contact Helplines:** 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333.

Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times.

- **Timings:** Monday to Friday 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM; Saturday 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM; closed on Sundays.

entries.question: What to do in document verification in Kumur in up neet pg alottment
entries.answer:
For document verification after a NEET PG seat allotment at King George's Medical University (KGMU), follow the official reporting guidelines provided through the UP NEET PG counseling process. 

Typically, you need to report in person to the designated verification center or KGMU campus with the following essential documents in original along with multiple sets of self-attested photocopies:
1. NEET PG Admit Card and Scorecard/Rank Letter
2. UP NEET PG Allotment Letter
3. Class 10th Certificate (for date of birth proof)
4. MBBS Degree Certificate and Marksheets (all professional years)
5. Permanent/Provisional Registration Certificate issued by MCI/NMC or State Medical Council
6. Compulsory Rotating Medical Internship (CMRI) completion certificate
7. Valid photo ID proof (Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID, or Passport)
8. Category/Caste certificate (OBC/SC/ST, if applicable, issued by the competent authority in the prescribed format)
9. EWS certificate (if applicable)
10. Domicile certificate (for UP state quota candidates)
11. Passport-size photographs (same as used in the NEET application)
12. Fee payment receipt (tuition/security fee as mandated by the counseling board)

*Note:* Please check your specific UP NEET PG allotment letter and the official counseling portal for exact reporting timelines, venue details, and any additional university-specific requirements.

For further admission details and official updates, visit the [KGMU Courses & Admission Page](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php).

entries.question: Abhi ham ko dikhana hai daktar ko
entries.answer:
To consult a doctor at KGMU OPD, please follow these steps:

1. **Online Registration (Mandatory):** Pre-booking your appointment is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times. You can book an appointment online via the [Online Registration System (ORS)](https://ors.gov.in), through the ABHA/Health Care App, or by sending an SMS (`APPOINTMENT <NAME>`) to **8887019134**. 
2. **OPD Slip Fee:** The OPD registration slip fee is ₹50 across all booking methods.
3. **Timings:** OPD registration and
 ticket counters are open Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM, and Saturdays from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM (closed on Sundays). The ticket counter closes sharply at 1:00 PM.
4. **Referral:** If you are coming from outside Lucknow, please bring a valid referral letter for the specific department you wish to visit.

If you have an urgent medical emergency, please proceed directly to the **KGMU Trauma Centre (Gate 14)**, which operates 24/7.

*Disclaimer: I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details in this chat for your safety.*

entries.question: Any other method online
entries.answer:
Yes, you can check or retrieve your appointment details online through the **Online Registration System (ORS)** portal, which is the official platform used for KGMU appointments:

1. Go to the official portal at [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in).
2. Log in using your registered mobile number and the OTP received on your phone.
3. Navigate to the **"Appointments"** or **"View Appointment / Download Slip"** section.
4. Enter the required patient details to view your active appointments and download a duplicate copy of your OPD slip. 

Alternatively, if you used the ABHA health app or another integrated healthcare portal for booking, log into that application with your registered mobile number to check your appointment history and retrieve your details.

entries.question: Book appointment today
entries.answer:
Online registration is mandatory to book an OPD appointment at KGMU. You can book an appointment using any of the following methods:

- **ORS Portal:** Visit [Online Registration System (ORS)](https://ors.gov.in) -> Select Uttar Pradesh -> KGMU -> New Appointment -> Choose department, date, and time -> Enter patient details -> Pay the ₹50 OPD slip fee -> Download the slip.
- **ABHA / Health Care App:** Register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same state and hospital selection flow.
- **SMS Booking:** Send an SMS in the format `Appointment [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**.
- **Walk-in:** Visit the hospital with your Aadhaar number and active mobile number to complete OTP verification, receive a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee, and collect your OPD slip. *(Note: Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times, and the ticket counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp.)*

For further assistance, you can contact the KGMU helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.

entries.question: I need today appointment
entries.answer:
To book an appointment for today at KGMU OPD, please note that online pre-booking is strongly recommended and the physical counter/ticket window closes at 1:00 PM sharp. 

You can use one of the following methods to book your OPD slip (fee: ₹50):

1. **Online via ORS:** Visit the [Online Registration System (ORS)](https://ors.gov.in), select Uttar Pradesh, choose KGMU, select your department, date, and complete the payment.
2. **Via SMS:** Send an SMS in the format `Appointment [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**.
3. **Walk-in:** Visit the OPD registration counter with your Aadhaar card and active mobile number to complete biometric/OTP verification and collect your physical token.

*Note:* If you are traveling from outside Lucknow, please ensure you bring a valid referral slip for the specific department. 

If you are experiencing a medical emergency, please proceed directly to the Trauma Centre (Gate 14) rather than the general OPD.
